d936.Raw_Article: 936 Kur. oŋgkhnā/uŋgkhnā (uŋgkhyas) to get drunk, be intoxicated; oŋgkhta'ānā to make drunk, produce loss of sensibility (as cold or chloroform), turn the head of.
